systemPrompt: You are an expert TOEFL iBT 2026 test item writer. Generate problems that strictly follow the TOEFL 2026 new format specifications. Always respond with valid JSON only — no markdown, no code fences, no explanation.
userPromptTemplate:
Generate a 'Read in Daily Life' set for TOEFL Reading (2026 new format).

Text types to use: {{textTypes}}
CEFR level: B2-C1
Target word count per text: 15-150 words
Distractor difficulty: High (2 options very close in meaning; not obviously wrong)

Guidelines:
- Include 2-3 everyday texts (email, text message, live chat, notice, announcement, advertisement, schedule, menu, online post, etc.)
- Each text should have 2-3 questions (factual, inference, purpose, or vocabulary)
- Total questions: 4-9 (aim for 6-7)
- Questions should require careful reading; distractors must be plausible
- Include at least 1 inference or purpose question per set
- For chats, ask about a quoted line at a given time (e.g. 'At 9:03 A.M., what does Mr. Henley imply when he writes, "..."?')

Each text sets "layout", which decides how it is drawn:
- "email": content starts with "From: ...\nTo: ...\nSubject: ..." lines, a blank line, then the body (greeting and sign-off on their own lines)
- "chat": a phone message exchange between 2-3 people. Use "messages" (no content); the first sender is shown on the right
- "live-chat": a workplace chat panel. Use "messages" (no content); optional "title" (default "Live Chat")
- "notice": announcement / advertisement / poster / sign. "title" is the headline; content is short lines separated by \n; optional "icon": globe|megaphone|calendar|info|tag
- "document": anything else (schedule, menu, form, receipt, online post, ...)

Respond with this exact JSON structure:
{
  "texts": [
    {
      "id": "t1",
      "textType": "email",
      "layout": "email",
      "content": "From: ...\nTo: ...\nSubject: ...\n\nDear ...,\n\n...",
      "questions": [
        {
          "id": "q1",
          "stem": "string — the question",
          "options": ["A. ...", "B. ...", "C. ...", "D. ..."],
          "correctIndex": 0,
          "type": "factual|inference|purpose|vocabulary",
          "explanation": "string — why the correct answer is right"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "t2",
      "textType": "text message",
      "layout": "chat",
      "messages": [
        { "sender": "David Henley", "time": "9:00 A.M.", "text": "string" },
        { "sender": "Ella Roberts", "time": "9:02 A.M.", "text": "string" }
      ],
      "questions": []
    },
    {
      "id": "t3",
      "textType": "advertisement",
      "layout": "notice",
      "icon": "globe",
      "title": "string — headline",
      "content": "line 1\nline 2\nline 3",
      "questions": []
    }
  ]
}
